verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a network connectivity and VPN platform, not a Git client or source-control host, so cloning repositories over HTTPS, SSH, or the Git protocol is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Tailscale shipping Git clone functionality. Tailscale SSH and connecting GitHub runners to private infrastructure are networking features, not Git operations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can clone Git repositories over HTTPS, SSH, or the Git protocol
